meta.title: Silver Lining
meta.description: The way ahead is distant and indistinct, and the heavy clouds obscure the stars' light.

units.rawText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: Eos looks into the distance, at the ruined Watchtower known as [objectTower_b2]. Alcyone is no longer in sight.
units.displayText: Eos looks into the distance, at the ruined Watchtower known as [objectTower_b2]. Alcyone is no longer in sight.

spans.text: Eos looks into the distance, at the ruined Watchtower known as [objectTower_b2]. Alcyone is no longer in sight.

units.rawText: Let's part ways here. According to our previous arrangement, Eos will travel with <cmdr> while I will go alone.
units.displayText: Let's part ways here. According to our previous arrangement, Eos will travel with {교수} while I will go alone.

spans.text: Let's part ways here. According to our previous arrangement, Eos will travel with
while I will go alone.

units.rawText: Comms are still impossible inside the Tartarus Sector, so take the utmost caution when moving. Send up a signal arrow if anything happens.
units.displayText: Comms are still impossible inside the Tartarus Sector, so take the utmost caution when moving. Send up a signal arrow if anything happens.

spans.text: Comms are still impossible inside the Tartarus Sector, so take the utmost caution when moving. Send up a signal arrow if anything happens.

units.rawText: Fortunately, the activation of a Halo can be seen from anywhere in the Middle Ring. Even without comms, we can monitor each other's status by keeping an eye on the Watchtowers.
units.displayText: Fortunately, the activation of a Halo can be seen from anywhere in the Middle Ring. Even without comms, we can monitor each other's status by keeping an eye on the Watchtowers.

spans.text: Fortunately, the activation of a Halo can be seen from anywhere in the Middle Ring. Even without comms, we can monitor each other's status by keeping an eye on the Watchtowers.

units.rawText: Heh, that does sound like something you'd say, <cmdr>. Let's see which of us can activate their tower first, then.
units.displayText: Heh, that does sound like something you'd say, {교수}. Let's see which of us can activate their tower first, then.

spans.text: Heh, that does sound like something you'd say,
. Let's see which of us can activate their tower first, then.

units.rawText: Eos, do you have any further questions?
units.displayText: Eos, do you have any further questions?

spans.text: Eos, do you have any further questions?

units.rawText: ...Eosphorus, we only need to have the Halos of 3 Watchtowers active at once to activate the Ring-wide Halo, right?
units.displayText: ...Eosphorus, we only need to have the Halos of 3 Watchtowers active at once to activate the Ring-wide Halo, right?

spans.text: ...Eosphorus, we only need to have the Halos of 3 Watchtowers active at once to activate the Ring-wide Halo, right?

units.rawText: Indeed. So it is written in the revelations. We've also seen the potency of the Halos before this, have we not?
units.displayText: Indeed. So it is written in the revelations. We've also seen the potency of the Halos before this, have we not?

spans.text: Indeed. So it is written in the revelations. We've also seen the potency of the Halos before this, have we not?

units.rawText: Once we activate the Halos, all the Entropics will be suppressed and we will be able to destroy Malkira...
units.displayText: Once we activate the Halos, all the Entropics will be suppressed and we will be able to destroy Malkira...

spans.text: Once we activate the Halos, all the Entropics will be suppressed and we will be able to destroy Malkira...

units.rawText: Yes. All the sacrifices we've made up to that point will have been worthwhile.
units.displayText: Yes. All the sacrifices we've made up to that point will have been worthwhile.

spans.text: Yes. All the sacrifices we've made up to that point will have been worthwhile.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' words seem to contain some kind of soothing magic. Eos nods, and looks away from the tower.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' words seem to contain some kind of soothing magic. Eos nods, and looks away from the tower.

spans.text: Eosphorus' words seem to contain some kind of soothing magic. Eos nods, and looks away from the tower.

units.rawText: Relax. You'd think we just lost a battle from the look on your face.
units.displayText: Relax. You'd think we just lost a battle from the look on your face.

spans.text: Relax. You'd think we just lost a battle from the look on your face.

units.rawText: ...Pardon me. I ought to readjust my emotional modules.
units.displayText: ...Pardon me. I ought to readjust my emotional modules.

spans.text: ...Pardon me. I ought to readjust my emotional modules.

units.rawText: You're giving yourself too much pressure. Go clear the redundant data in your system. Much as I'd like to give you a chance to rest and relax, we sadly do not have that time for that right now.
units.displayText: You're giving yourself too much pressure. Go clear the redundant data in your system. Much as I'd like to give you a chance to rest and relax, we sadly do not have that time for that right now.

spans.text: You're giving yourself too much pressure. Go clear the redundant data in your system. Much as I'd like to give you a chance to rest and relax, we sadly do not have that time for that right now.

units.rawText: Even now, Entropic forces are returning from the frontlines to reinforce this place. Hesperus leads our frontline units, but even he cannot divert the attention of all the creatures in the Tartarus Sector forever.
units.displayText: Even now, Entropic forces are returning from the frontlines to reinforce this place. Hesperus leads our frontline units, but even he cannot divert the attention of all the creatures in the Tartarus Sector forever.

spans.text: Even now, Entropic forces are returning from the frontlines to reinforce this place. Hesperus leads our frontline units, but even he cannot divert the attention of all the creatures in the Tartarus Sector forever.

units.rawText: I understand. Time is precious, and we can't let this slow our future movements.
units.displayText: I understand. Time is precious, and we can't let this slow our future movements.

spans.text: I understand. Time is precious, and we can't let this slow our future movements.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, make sure you take care of Eos afterwards.
units.displayText: {교수}, make sure you take care of Eos afterwards.

spans.text: , make sure you take care of Eos afterwards.

units.rawText: Eosphorus turns to me and solemnly pats me on the shoulder before turning to leave.
units.displayText: Eosphorus turns to me and solemnly pats me on the shoulder before turning to leave.

spans.text: Eosphorus turns to me and solemnly pats me on the shoulder before turning to leave.

units.rawText: Eos, let's get a move on. Are you okay?
units.displayText: Eos, let's get a move on. Are you okay?

spans.text: Eos, let's get a move on. Are you okay?

units.rawText: <cmdr>.
units.displayText: {교수}.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Did Eosphorus tell you why we Sanctifiers were weakened?
units.displayText: Did Eosphorus tell you why we Sanctifiers were weakened?

spans.text: Did Eosphorus tell you why we Sanctifiers were weakened?
(Use the reason Eosphorus told Alcyone.)
(Tell the truth.)

units.rawText: ...There was malware in the Rubik's Map, and it affected us all the instant I retrieved it.
units.displayText: ...There was malware in the Rubik's Map, and it affected us all the instant I retrieved it.

spans.text: ...There was malware in the Rubik's Map, and it affected us all the instant I retrieved it.

units.rawText: I was with Eosphorus back then, <cmdr>. There was a long distance between us. Have you ever seen malware with such range and potency?
units.displayText: I was with Eosphorus back then, {교수}. There was a long distance between us. Have you ever seen malware with such range and potency?

spans.text: I was with Eosphorus back then,
. There was a long distance between us. Have you ever seen malware with such range and potency?

units.rawText: I know Eosphorus must have discussed this with you in private. I know him; the moment he thinks he needs help, his first instinct is to go to you.
units.displayText: I know Eosphorus must have discussed this with you in private. I know him; the moment he thinks he needs help, his first instinct is to go to you.

spans.text: I know Eosphorus must have discussed this with you in private. I know him; the moment he thinks he needs help, his first instinct is to go to you.

units.rawText: ...We did discuss some possibilities, but...
units.displayText: ...We did discuss some possibilities, but...

spans.text: ...We did discuss some possibilities, but...

units.rawText: It's alright, <cmdr>. I'm not here to censure you or learn the details of your conversation. We have different perspectives, so I believe you had your reasons for saying what you did.
units.displayText: It's alright, {교수}. I'm not here to censure you or learn the details of your conversation. We have different perspectives, so I believe you had your reasons for saying what you did.

spans.text: It's alright,
. I'm not here to censure you or learn the details of your conversation. We have different perspectives, so I believe you had your reasons for saying what you did.

units.rawText: But Tartarus' weakening of the Sanctifiers was far too absurd, both in terms of its trigger and execution. That absurdity was the most terrifying thing about it, and I simply could not calm my uneasiness.
units.displayText: But Tartarus' weakening of the Sanctifiers was far too absurd, both in terms of its trigger and execution. That absurdity was the most terrifying thing about it, and I simply could not calm my uneasiness.

spans.text: But Tartarus' weakening of the Sanctifiers was far too absurd, both in terms of its trigger and execution. That absurdity was the most terrifying thing about it, and I simply could not calm my uneasiness.

units.rawText: Perhaps Eosphorus didn't believe it himself. He simply told me his guess.
units.displayText: Perhaps Eosphorus didn't believe it himself. He simply told me his guess.

spans.text: Perhaps Eosphorus didn't believe it himself. He simply told me his guess.

units.rawText: Given the guess led toward a blasphemous conclusion, nobody could have spoken it out loud.
units.displayText: Given the guess led toward a blasphemous conclusion, nobody could have spoken it out loud.

spans.text: Given the guess led toward a blasphemous conclusion, nobody could have spoken it out loud.

units.rawText: ...I understand. Tartarus' weakening of the Sanctifiers was far too absurd, both in terms of its trigger and execution. That absurdity was the most terrifying thing about it, and I simply could not calm my uneasiness.
units.displayText: ...I understand. Tartarus' weakening of the Sanctifiers was far too absurd, both in terms of its trigger and execution. That absurdity was the most terrifying thing about it, and I simply could not calm my uneasiness.

spans.text: ...I understand. Tartarus' weakening of the Sanctifiers was far too absurd, both in terms of its trigger and execution. That absurdity was the most terrifying thing about it, and I simply could not calm my uneasiness.

units.rawText: I told you before that I know Eosphorus very well, and if I felt uneasy about something, then he would, too... And in truth, I could guess what you were talking about.
units.displayText: I told you before that I know Eosphorus very well, and if I felt uneasy about something, then he would, too... And in truth, I could guess what you were talking about.

spans.text: I told you before that I know Eosphorus very well, and if I felt uneasy about something, then he would, too... And in truth, I could guess what you were talking about.

units.rawText: Eos looks in the direction where Eosphorus left.
units.displayText: Eos looks in the direction where Eosphorus left.

spans.text: Eos looks in the direction where Eosphorus left.

units.rawText: Your conversation with Eosphorus involved the gods, right?
units.displayText: Your conversation with Eosphorus involved the gods, right?

spans.text: Your conversation with Eosphorus involved the gods, right?
(Agree.)
(Remain silent)
(Deny it.)

units.rawText: Indeed.
units.displayText: Indeed.

spans.text: Indeed.

units.rawText: Not really.
units.displayText: Not really.

spans.text: Not really.

units.rawText: Eos looks me in the eye, then shakes her head a moment later.
units.displayText: Eos looks me in the eye, then shakes her head a moment later.

spans.text: Eos looks me in the eye, then shakes her head a moment later.

units.rawText: You really are bad at telling lies, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: You really are bad at telling lies, {교수}.

spans.text: You really are bad at telling lies,

units.rawText: I just can't keep anything from you.
units.displayText: I just can't keep anything from you.

spans.text: I just can't keep anything from you.

units.rawText: ...The truth is, I'm a little worried about Eosphorus. This mission is an all-or-nothing bet. We had no choice, given the deadline the gods set.
units.displayText: ...The truth is, I'm a little worried about Eosphorus. This mission is an all-or-nothing bet. We had no choice, given the deadline the gods set.

spans.text: ...The truth is, I'm a little worried about Eosphorus. This mission is an all-or-nothing bet. We had no choice, given the deadline the gods set.

units.rawText: When Eosphorus is unsettled, he turns to his faith for spiritual support and to his "voice of reason" for solace. But if either of them should lose their effect...
units.displayText: When Eosphorus is unsettled, he turns to his faith for spiritual support and to his "voice of reason" for solace. But if either of them should lose their effect...

spans.text: When Eosphorus is unsettled, he turns to his faith for spiritual support and to his "voice of reason" for solace. But if either of them should lose their effect...

units.rawText: Eos lowers her head, her sleeves fluttering in the wind as her Sanctifier's badge glitters. After a moment of silence, she looks back toward me.
units.displayText: Eos lowers her head, her sleeves fluttering in the wind as her Sanctifier's badge glitters. After a moment of silence, she looks back toward me.

spans.text: Eos lowers her head, her sleeves fluttering in the wind as her Sanctifier's badge glitters. After a moment of silence, she looks back toward me.

units.rawText: Eosphorus is so strong that nobody in the Reverse Tower can imagine him being miserable or fragile. But I know what that looks like, and so do you.
units.displayText: Eosphorus is so strong that nobody in the Reverse Tower can imagine him being miserable or fragile. But I know what that looks like, and so do you.

spans.text: Eosphorus is so strong that nobody in the Reverse Tower can imagine him being miserable or fragile. But I know what that looks like, and so do you.

units.rawText: If anything really happens, then I'll be counting on you to do what's best for him, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: If anything really happens, then I'll be counting on you to do what's best for him, {교수}.

spans.text: If anything really happens, then I'll be counting on you to do what's best for him,

units.rawText: After whispering those words, Eos looks back up and smiles at me while taking my hand, as though nothing had happened.
units.displayText: After whispering those words, Eos looks back up and smiles at me while taking my hand, as though nothing had happened.

spans.text: After whispering those words, Eos looks back up and smiles at me while taking my hand, as though nothing had happened.

units.rawText: Let's go take down the other tower.
units.displayText: Let's go take down the other tower.

spans.text: Let's go take down the other tower.

units.rawText: Shortly afterwards, in the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Shortly afterwards, in the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Shortly afterwards, in the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: In the former Sanctifier Watchtower designated [objectTower_b3].
units.displayText: In the former Sanctifier Watchtower designated [objectTower_b3].

spans.text: In the former Sanctifier Watchtower designated [objectTower_b3].

units.rawText: Eosphorus slowly walks toward the Watchtower, holding the relic in his right hand. His fierce, sharp operands easily disintegrate any Entropics that cross his path.
units.displayText: Eosphorus slowly walks toward the Watchtower, holding the relic in his right hand. His fierce, sharp operands easily disintegrate any Entropics that cross his path.

spans.text: Eosphorus slowly walks toward the Watchtower, holding the relic in his right hand. His fierce, sharp operands easily disintegrate any Entropics that cross his path.

units.rawText: Welcome, Eos...
units.displayText: Welcome, Eos...

spans.text: Welcome, Eos...

units.rawText: The girl at the entrance is cut to pieces before she can finish speaking. Eosphorus steps over the Ptolemaea-chunks and enters the Watchtower, where he is greeted by another curtsying girl.
units.displayText: The girl at the entrance is cut to pieces before she can finish speaking. Eosphorus steps over the Ptolemaea-chunks and enters the Watchtower, where he is greeted by another curtsying girl.

spans.text: The girl at the entrance is cut to pieces before she can finish speaking. Eosphorus steps over the Ptolemaea-chunks and enters the Watchtower, where he is greeted by another curtsying girl.

units.rawText: It seems your understanding of the relic has improved further. I believe you'll have fully mastered this weapon before long, no?
units.displayText: It seems your understanding of the relic has improved further. I believe you'll have fully mastered this weapon before long, no?

spans.text: It seems your understanding of the relic has improved further. I believe you'll have fully mastered this weapon before long, no?

units.rawText: I wonder what will happen when you fully unleash this sword's power?
units.displayText: I wonder what will happen when you fully unleash this sword's power?

spans.text: I wonder what will happen when you fully unleash this sword's power?

units.rawText: What's this? Does it discomfort the Entropics that I am learning more about the relic?
units.displayText: What's this? Does it discomfort the Entropics that I am learning more about the relic?

spans.text: What's this? Does it discomfort the Entropics that I am learning more about the relic?

units.rawText: (Sigh) You Sanctifiers are always so hostile. Why can't you just use something like that as a conversation starter?
units.displayText: (Sigh) You Sanctifiers are always so hostile. Why can't you just use something like that as a conversation starter?

spans.text: (Sigh) You Sanctifiers are always so hostile. Why can't you just use something like that as a conversation starter?

units.rawText: As you know, the ball has begun, but before the host speaks and the band officially begins playing, there will be a short time for the guests to mingle and speak.
units.displayText: As you know, the ball has begun, but before the host speaks and the band officially begins playing, there will be a short time for the guests to mingle and speak.

spans.text: As you know, the ball has begun, but before the host speaks and the band officially begins playing, there will be a short time for the guests to mingle and speak.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea seems to consider Eosphorus a familiar, trusted companion. She turns aside and gestures for him to continue onward as he passes by.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea seems to consider Eosphorus a familiar, trusted companion. She turns aside and gestures for him to continue onward as he passes by.

spans.text: Ptolemaea seems to consider Eosphorus a familiar, trusted companion. She turns aside and gestures for him to continue onward as he passes by.

units.rawText: Part of this tower's lower level has collapsed for various reasons. If you wish to head to the roof, you may proceed this way.
units.displayText: Part of this tower's lower level has collapsed for various reasons. If you wish to head to the roof, you may proceed this way.

spans.text: Part of this tower's lower level has collapsed for various reasons. If you wish to head to the roof, you may proceed this way.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' sword hand trembles, but in the end, he chooses not to strike. He takes a deep breath before blinking, then smiles.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' sword hand trembles, but in the end, he chooses not to strike. He takes a deep breath before blinking, then smiles.

spans.text: Eosphorus' sword hand trembles, but in the end, he chooses not to strike. He takes a deep breath before blinking, then smiles.

units.rawText: Please lead the way, then.
units.displayText: Please lead the way, then.

spans.text: Please lead the way, then.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea looks up at Eosphorus. For the first time, she seems surprised.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea looks up at Eosphorus. For the first time, she seems surprised.

spans.text: Ptolemaea looks up at Eosphorus. For the first time, she seems surprised.

units.rawText: ...It would be my pleasure.
units.displayText: ...It would be my pleasure.

spans.text: ...It would be my pleasure.

units.rawText: Please come this way, then. You can take a left turn here to return to the stairs and continue on the proper way to the Watchtower's roof.
units.displayText: Please come this way, then. You can take a left turn here to return to the stairs and continue on the proper way to the Watchtower's roof.

spans.text: Please come this way, then. You can take a left turn here to return to the stairs and continue on the proper way to the Watchtower's roof.

units.rawText: Is the Halo system in the center of the roof?
units.displayText: Is the Halo system in the center of the roof?

spans.text: Is the Halo system in the center of the roof?

units.rawText: Of course. The collapse did not affect the structure of the upper levels.
units.displayText: Of course. The collapse did not affect the structure of the upper levels.

spans.text: Of course. The collapse did not affect the structure of the upper levels.

units.rawText: Sounds like good news.
units.displayText: Sounds like good news.

spans.text: Sounds like good news.

units.rawText: Are you curious about my sudden change in attitude?
units.displayText: Are you curious about my sudden change in attitude?

spans.text: Are you curious about my sudden change in attitude?

units.rawText: I am merely ashamed that I do not know my partner as well as I ought to.
units.displayText: I am merely ashamed that I do not know my partner as well as I ought to.

spans.text: I am merely ashamed that I do not know my partner as well as I ought to.

units.rawText: I can help you understand. All you need to know is this—the Sanctifiers will wipe out all Entropics. That is our purpose and the will of the gods.
units.displayText: I can help you understand. All you need to know is this—the Sanctifiers will wipe out all Entropics. That is our purpose and the will of the gods.

spans.text: I can help you understand. All you need to know is this—the Sanctifiers will wipe out all Entropics. That is our purpose and the will of the gods.

units.rawText: I am willing to see what tricks you have prepared to shake my faith. If these tricks end up helping me accomplish my mission more quickly, so much the better.
units.displayText: I am willing to see what tricks you have prepared to shake my faith. If these tricks end up helping me accomplish my mission more quickly, so much the better.

spans.text: I am willing to see what tricks you have prepared to shake my faith. If these tricks end up helping me accomplish my mission more quickly, so much the better.

units.rawText: ...Hehehe.
units.displayText: ...Hehehe.

spans.text: ...Hehehe.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea chuckles, and her laughter echoes throughout the interior of the quiet Watchtower.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea chuckles, and her laughter echoes throughout the interior of the quiet Watchtower.

spans.text: Ptolemaea chuckles, and her laughter echoes throughout the interior of the quiet Watchtower.

units.rawText: When I first met you, I found your conduct and that of your companion boring. You were nothing like the information I had obtained about you. Now, however, you seem as interesting as the persona I imagined for you in the past.
units.displayText: When I first met you, I found your conduct and that of your companion boring. You were nothing like the information I had obtained about you. Now, however, you seem as interesting as the persona I imagined for you in the past.

spans.text: When I first met you, I found your conduct and that of your companion boring. You were nothing like the information I had obtained about you. Now, however, you seem as interesting as the persona I imagined for you in the past.

units.rawText: You've researched me?
units.displayText: You've researched me?

spans.text: You've researched me?

units.rawText: The battle of Warzone Somme, the aerial battle at 0426CGN, the ambush of Warzone Boulder... We've clashed many times before, just in different ways from right now.
units.displayText: The battle of Warzone Somme, the aerial battle at 0426CGN, the ambush of Warzone Boulder... We've clashed many times before, just in different ways from right now.

spans.text: The battle of Warzone Somme, the aerial battle at 0426CGN, the ambush of Warzone Boulder... We've clashed many times before, just in different ways from right now.

units.rawText: So you were the Entropic behind those incidents... But you've made one mistake. I was not the one who crushed the Entropic ambush at Warzone Boulder.
units.displayText: So you were the Entropic behind those incidents... But you've made one mistake. I was not the one who crushed the Entropic ambush at Warzone Boulder.

spans.text: So you were the Entropic behind those incidents... But you've made one mistake. I was not the one who crushed the Entropic ambush at Warzone Boulder.

units.rawText: ...Ah, was it <cmdr>? No wonder. Our setbacks during the ambush back then dealt a fatal blow to our overall deployment. Both the execution and timing were most exquisite; it left a deep impression on me.
units.displayText: ...Ah, was it {교수}? No wonder. Our setbacks during the ambush back then dealt a fatal blow to our overall deployment. Both the execution and timing were most exquisite; it left a deep impression on me.

spans.text: ...Ah, was it
? No wonder. Our setbacks during the ambush back then dealt a fatal blow to our overall deployment. Both the execution and timing were most exquisite; it left a deep impression on me.

units.rawText: If the Reverse Tower had more Sanctifiers like you and <cmdr>, the Entropics would be having a harder time.
units.displayText: If the Reverse Tower had more Sanctifiers like you and {교수}, the Entropics would be having a harder time.

spans.text: If the Reverse Tower had more Sanctifiers like you and
, the Entropics would be having a harder time.

units.rawText: You flatter me.
units.displayText: You flatter me.

spans.text: You flatter me.

units.rawText: Which is why I'm curious.
units.displayText: Which is why I'm curious.

spans.text: Which is why I'm curious.

units.rawText: About what?
units.displayText: About what?

spans.text: About what?

units.rawText: I'm curious as to why, despite being taken by surprise and weakened, you would still choose to continue deeper into the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: I'm curious as to why, despite being taken by surprise and weakened, you would still choose to continue deeper into the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: I'm curious as to why, despite being taken by surprise and weakened, you would still choose to continue deeper into the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: If you wish to persuade us to withdraw, you can save your effort.
units.displayText: If you wish to persuade us to withdraw, you can save your effort.

spans.text: If you wish to persuade us to withdraw, you can save your effort.

units.rawText: We have the relic and there is the Halo system in the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: We have the relic and there is the Halo system in the Middle Ring.

spans.text: We have the relic and there is the Halo system in the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: The first is an unrivaled weapon. The second has been successfully activated to suppress hordes of Entropics, and when fully activated, it can even reach the Inner Ring. Why should we not carry on?
units.displayText: The first is an unrivaled weapon. The second has been successfully activated to suppress hordes of Entropics, and when fully activated, it can even reach the Inner Ring. Why should we not carry on?

spans.text: The first is an unrivaled weapon. The second has been successfully activated to suppress hordes of Entropics, and when fully activated, it can even reach the Inner Ring. Why should we not carry on?

units.rawText: Eosphorus comes to a halt. He and Ptolemaea have reached the center of the Watchtower's roof, and the core control terminal stands before the two of them.
units.displayText: Eosphorus comes to a halt. He and Ptolemaea have reached the center of the Watchtower's roof, and the core control terminal stands before the two of them.

spans.text: Eosphorus comes to a halt. He and Ptolemaea have reached the center of the Watchtower's roof, and the core control terminal stands before the two of them.

units.rawText: Do you need me to clear away the surface corruption?
units.displayText: Do you need me to clear away the surface corruption?

spans.text: Do you need me to clear away the surface corruption?

units.rawText: I can do it myself.
units.displayText: I can do it myself.

spans.text: I can do it myself.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea shrugs and stands aside. She continues asking Eosphorus questions as she leans against a nearby wall.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea shrugs and stands aside. She continues asking Eosphorus questions as she leans against a nearby wall.

spans.text: Ptolemaea shrugs and stands aside. She continues asking Eosphorus questions as she leans against a nearby wall.

units.rawText: Indeed, the relic is most devastating to Entropics. The Halo system is even more troublesome. However, you could not guarantee their possession before you set out.
units.displayText: Indeed, the relic is most devastating to Entropics. The Halo system is even more troublesome. However, you could not guarantee their possession before you set out.

spans.text: Indeed, the relic is most devastating to Entropics. The Halo system is even more troublesome. However, you could not guarantee their possession before you set out.

units.rawText: Why were you so confident that you could obtain them? Or are you saying that you are carrying on to take revenge for your friends? If I'm not wrong, that Sanctifier's name was—
units.displayText: Why were you so confident that you could obtain them? Or are you saying that you are carrying on to take revenge for your friends? If I'm not wrong, that Sanctifier's name was—

spans.text: Why were you so confident that you could obtain them? Or are you saying that you are carrying on to take revenge for your friends? If I'm not wrong, that Sanctifier's name was—

units.rawText: Slash—
units.displayText: Slash—

spans.text: Slash—

units.rawText: Before she can finish speaking, Ptolemaea's body is promptly cut to pieces.
units.displayText: Before she can finish speaking, Ptolemaea's body is promptly cut to pieces.

spans.text: Before she can finish speaking, Ptolemaea's body is promptly cut to pieces.

units.rawText: Eosphorus puts away the relic without looking back and continues working on the core terminal.
units.displayText: Eosphorus puts away the relic without looking back and continues working on the core terminal.

spans.text: Eosphorus puts away the relic without looking back and continues working on the core terminal.

units.rawText: I do not recall giving you permission to speak his name.
units.displayText: I do not recall giving you permission to speak his name.

spans.text: I do not recall giving you permission to speak his name.

units.rawText: (Sigh)
units.displayText: Sigh

spans.text: Sigh

units.rawText: A brand-new Ptolemaea steps out of the shadows. She picks a high place and sits down there, resting her chin in her hands as she watches Eosphorus work.
units.displayText: A brand-new Ptolemaea steps out of the shadows. She picks a high place and sits down there, resting her chin in her hands as she watches Eosphorus work.

spans.text: A brand-new Ptolemaea steps out of the shadows. She picks a high place and sits down there, resting her chin in her hands as she watches Eosphorus work.

units.rawText: Even the time constraints of this operation came from the revelations of your gods, right?
units.displayText: Even the time constraints of this operation came from the revelations of your gods, right?

spans.text: Even the time constraints of this operation came from the revelations of your gods, right?

units.rawText: Ahhh, I'm bored now. I thought I'd be able to see another side of you Sanctifiers, but you're still the same. Your devotion to the gods verges on the mindless.
units.displayText: Ahhh, I'm bored now. I thought I'd be able to see another side of you Sanctifiers, but you're still the same. Your devotion to the gods verges on the mindless.

spans.text: Ahhh, I'm bored now. I thought I'd be able to see another side of you Sanctifiers, but you're still the same. Your devotion to the gods verges on the mindless.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea narrows her eyes, and the way lines of code race through her eyes is as though she's receiving a divine revelation of her own.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea narrows her eyes, and the way lines of code race through her eyes is as though she's receiving a divine revelation of her own.

spans.text: Ptolemaea narrows her eyes, and the way lines of code race through her eyes is as though she's receiving a divine revelation of her own.

units.rawText: If just obtaining the Rubik's Map had such ruinous effects on the Sanctifiers, then do you not think activating the Halo system would have ill effects of its own?
units.displayText: If just obtaining the Rubik's Map had such ruinous effects on the Sanctifiers, then do you not think activating the Halo system would have ill effects of its own?

spans.text: If just obtaining the Rubik's Map had such ruinous effects on the Sanctifiers, then do you not think activating the Halo system would have ill effects of its own?

units.rawText: What happens if we continue further into the Tartarus Sector and encounter more ridiculous "malware"?
units.displayText: What happens if we continue further into the Tartarus Sector and encounter more ridiculous "malware"?

spans.text: What happens if we continue further into the Tartarus Sector and encounter more ridiculous "malware"?

units.rawText: Then we'll just have to overcome them.
units.displayText: Then we'll just have to overcome them.

spans.text: Then we'll just have to overcome them.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' hands pause briefly over the control panel, but he soon returns to normal.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' hands pause briefly over the control panel, but he soon returns to normal.

spans.text: Eosphorus' hands pause briefly over the control panel, but he soon returns to normal.

units.rawText: Then we will simply overcome the penance we have been assigned.
units.displayText: Then we will simply overcome the penance we have been assigned.

spans.text: Then we will simply overcome the penance we have been assigned.

units.rawText: Oh? Even if the ones punishing you are the very gods you revere?
units.displayText: Oh? Even if the ones punishing you are the very gods you revere?

spans.text: Oh? Even if the ones punishing you are the very gods you revere?

units.rawText: Eosphorus straightens up and looks at Ptolemaea, then hits the activation key.
units.displayText: Eosphorus straightens up and looks at Ptolemaea, then hits the activation key.

spans.text: Eosphorus straightens up and looks at Ptolemaea, then hits the activation key.

units.rawText: We Sanctifiers are the defenders of Magrasea. Protecting the cloud server is our calling.
units.displayText: We Sanctifiers are the defenders of Magrasea. Protecting the cloud server is our calling.

spans.text: We Sanctifiers are the defenders of Magrasea. Protecting the cloud server is our calling.

units.rawText: That's a good answer. Certainly better than something along the lines of "my faith is beyond question".
units.displayText: That's a good answer. Certainly better than something along the lines of "my faith is beyond question".

spans.text: That's a good answer. Certainly better than something along the lines of "my faith is beyond question".

units.rawText: Eosphorus turns to the source of the voice, his systems primed and ready for battle. The fact that the Entropic managed to come so close without him even detecting her makes his heart sink.
units.displayText: Eosphorus turns to the source of the voice, his systems primed and ready for battle. The fact that the Entropic managed to come so close without him even detecting her makes his heart sink.

spans.text: Eosphorus turns to the source of the voice, his systems primed and ready for battle. The fact that the Entropic managed to come so close without him even detecting her makes his heart sink.

units.rawText: I told you earlier. The ball has begun, but before the host speaks and the band officially begins playing, there will be a short time for the guests to mingle and speak.
units.displayText: I told you earlier. The ball has begun, but before the host speaks and the band officially begins playing, there will be a short time for the guests to mingle and speak.

spans.text: I told you earlier. The ball has begun, but before the host speaks and the band officially begins playing, there will be a short time for the guests to mingle and speak.

units.rawText: The two of us have spoken at great length and leisure time is over. The following time will naturally be yielded to my noble master.
units.displayText: The two of us have spoken at great length and leisure time is over. The following time will naturally be yielded to my noble master.

spans.text: The two of us have spoken at great length and leisure time is over. The following time will naturally be yielded to my noble master.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea leaps down from where she is sitting and curtsies, then steps aside.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea leaps down from where she is sitting and curtsies, then steps aside.

spans.text: Ptolemaea leaps down from where she is sitting and curtsies, then steps aside.

units.rawText: A figure slowly emerges from the shadows, seated upon a grand throne of interlocking, writhing tentacles.
units.displayText: A figure slowly emerges from the shadows, seated upon a grand throne of interlocking, writhing tentacles.

spans.text: A figure slowly emerges from the shadows, seated upon a grand throne of interlocking, writhing tentacles.

units.rawText: I've come to see you, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: I've come to see you, Eosphorus.

spans.text: I've come to see you, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Your operand levels... Are you a clone?
units.displayText: Your operand levels... Are you a clone?

spans.text: Your operand levels... Are you a clone?

units.rawText: It seems you aren't being very sincere about this meeting.
units.displayText: It seems you aren't being very sincere about this meeting.

spans.text: It seems you aren't being very sincere about this meeting.

units.rawText: I would like to meet you in person, of course, but unfortunately a caged bird can't unlock its own prison.
units.displayText: I would like to meet you in person, of course, but unfortunately a caged bird can't unlock its own prison.

spans.text: I would like to meet you in person, of course, but unfortunately a caged bird can't unlock its own prison.

units.rawText: Relax. I had no intention of hiding myself. However, your limited warning systems were no longer able to detect me.
units.displayText: Relax. I had no intention of hiding myself. However, your limited warning systems were no longer able to detect me.

spans.text: Relax. I had no intention of hiding myself. However, your limited warning systems were no longer able to detect me.

units.rawText: Still, that is alright. I forgive you for being cautious. This is only your first time meeting me, after all. More importantly, I'm very interested in you, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Still, that is alright. I forgive you for being cautious. This is only your first time meeting me, after all. More importantly, I'm very interested in you, Eosphorus.

spans.text: Still, that is alright. I forgive you for being cautious. This is only your first time meeting me, after all. More importantly, I'm very interested in you, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Judging by your tone, you've seen me before.
units.displayText: Judging by your tone, you've seen me before.

spans.text: Judging by your tone, you've seen me before.

units.rawText: Of course. I've been looking forward to this day... to the day you could reach this place, to the day you could stand before me.
units.displayText: Of course. I've been looking forward to this day... to the day you could reach this place, to the day you could stand before me.

spans.text: Of course. I've been looking forward to this day... to the day you could reach this place, to the day you could stand before me.

units.rawText: Be at ease. I will reach you like you want, and then I will destroy you.
units.displayText: Be at ease. I will reach you like you want, and then I will destroy you.

spans.text: Be at ease. I will reach you like you want, and then I will destroy you.

units.rawText: How cold... I thought everything Ptolemaea did was enough to show you the kindness of the Entropics. Why are you still so harsh and aloof?
units.displayText: How cold... I thought everything Ptolemaea did was enough to show you the kindness of the Entropics. Why are you still so harsh and aloof?

spans.text: How cold... I thought everything Ptolemaea did was enough to show you the kindness of the Entropics. Why are you still so harsh and aloof?

units.rawText: Could you not treat me the way you did her just now?
units.displayText: Could you not treat me the way you did her just now?

spans.text: Could you not treat me the way you did her just now?

units.rawText: Malkira puts on a show of being hurt. Even the tentacles below her droop sadly on the ground.
units.displayText: Malkira puts on a show of being hurt. Even the tentacles below her droop sadly on the ground.

spans.text: Malkira puts on a show of being hurt. Even the tentacles below her droop sadly on the ground.

units.rawText: However, this does not shake Eosphorus. His thorny aura of hostility does not fade.
units.displayText: However, this does not shake Eosphorus. His thorny aura of hostility does not fade.

spans.text: However, this does not shake Eosphorus. His thorny aura of hostility does not fade.

units.rawText: I have no interest in your disingenuous display. Our relationship is simple; we are nothing more than pesticide and pest, not audience and actor.
units.displayText: I have no interest in your disingenuous display. Our relationship is simple; we are nothing more than pesticide and pest, not audience and actor.

spans.text: I have no interest in your disingenuous display. Our relationship is simple; we are nothing more than pesticide and pest, not audience and actor.

units.rawText: If you Entropics truly had kind intentions for the Sanctifiers, if you sought some means of peaceful resolution... or other, more absurd and ridiculous considerations, then why not come clean at our first encounter?
units.displayText: If you Entropics truly had kind intentions for the Sanctifiers, if you sought some means of peaceful resolution... or other, more absurd and ridiculous considerations, then why not come clean at our first encounter?

spans.text: If you Entropics truly had kind intentions for the Sanctifiers, if you sought some means of peaceful resolution... or other, more absurd and ridiculous considerations, then why not come clean at our first encounter?

units.rawText: Because not every Sanctifier deserves the kindness of the Entropics.
units.displayText: Because not every Sanctifier deserves the kindness of the Entropics.

spans.text: Because not every Sanctifier deserves the kindness of the Entropics.

units.rawText: And here I thought I had already used up my one chance.
units.displayText: And here I thought I had already used up my one chance.

spans.text: And here I thought I had already used up my one chance.

units.rawText: You can have as many chances as you want. The same applies to Hesperus, who is brawling with my children on the frontlines.
units.displayText: You can have as many chances as you want. The same applies to Hesperus, who is brawling with my children on the frontlines.

spans.text: You can have as many chances as you want. The same applies to Hesperus, who is brawling with my children on the frontlines.

units.rawText: The world of the Entropics is much more direct than that of the Sanctifiers. An individual with potential will receive more chances than those who do not.
units.displayText: The world of the Entropics is much more direct than that of the Sanctifiers. An individual with potential will receive more chances than those who do not.

spans.text: The world of the Entropics is much more direct than that of the Sanctifiers. An individual with potential will receive more chances than those who do not.

units.rawText: Malkira's tone shifts from hurt to delight in an instant. She peers outside the window, looking at the other two Watchtowers through the glass. There is a hint of mockery in her tone.
units.displayText: Malkira's tone shifts from hurt to delight in an instant. She peers outside the window, looking at the other two Watchtowers through the glass. There is a hint of mockery in her tone.

spans.text: Malkira's tone shifts from hurt to delight in an instant. She peers outside the window, looking at the other two Watchtowers through the glass. There is a hint of mockery in her tone.

units.rawText: Also, I wish to emphasize this: ever since the Sanctifiers set foot in the Tartarus Sector, you were no longer the arbiter of the nature of our relationship.
units.displayText: Also, I wish to emphasize this: ever since the Sanctifiers set foot in the Tartarus Sector, you were no longer the arbiter of the nature of our relationship.

spans.text: Also, I wish to emphasize this: ever since the Sanctifiers set foot in the Tartarus Sector, you were no longer the arbiter of the nature of our relationship.

units.rawText: If I want to see how this all plays out, then the Sanctifiers will all have to play their roles.
units.displayText: If I want to see how this all plays out, then the Sanctifiers will all have to play their roles.

spans.text: If I want to see how this all plays out, then the Sanctifiers will all have to play their roles.

units.rawText: You have clones in the other two Watchtowers?!
units.displayText: You have clones in the other two Watchtowers?!

spans.text: You have clones in the other two Watchtowers?!

units.rawText: Now, why would you think that? It seems you still don't understand the lengths to which I've gone. There is a price to be paid for meeting you in the Middle Ring. My sincerity does not come cheap.
units.displayText: Now, why would you think that? It seems you still don't understand the lengths to which I've gone. There is a price to be paid for meeting you in the Middle Ring. My sincerity does not come cheap.

spans.text: Now, why would you think that? It seems you still don't understand the lengths to which I've gone. There is a price to be paid for meeting you in the Middle Ring. My sincerity does not come cheap.

units.rawText: Still, that too is fine. Expectations are merely expectations, nothing more. I'm curious as to how far you can go.
units.displayText: Still, that too is fine. Expectations are merely expectations, nothing more. I'm curious as to how far you can go.

spans.text: Still, that too is fine. Expectations are merely expectations, nothing more. I'm curious as to how far you can go.

units.rawText: Malkira's face goes blank again. She yawns lazily and sits down by a corner, hugging her legs.
units.displayText: Malkira's face goes blank again. She yawns lazily and sits down by a corner, hugging her legs.

spans.text: Malkira's face goes blank again. She yawns lazily and sits down by a corner, hugging her legs.

units.rawText: Below her, the drooping tentacles suddenly go erect and bristle with sharp points.
units.displayText: Below her, the drooping tentacles suddenly go erect and bristle with sharp points.

spans.text: Below her, the drooping tentacles suddenly go erect and bristle with sharp points.

units.rawText: Come then, Eosphorus. Let me see if you can surprise me after obtaining the relic.
units.displayText: Come then, Eosphorus. Let me see if you can surprise me after obtaining the relic.

spans.text: Come then, Eosphorus. Let me see if you can surprise me after obtaining the relic.
